attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.lead: Clock in when you arrive and clock out when you leave. Times are taken from the server clock.
attendance.status_in_sub: Clock out when you leave the clinic.
attendance.status_out_sub: Clock in when you start your shift.
attendance.qr_only_hint: Your clinic records attendance by scanning the QR code on the attendance screen at reception.
attendance.missing_out_meta: Ask a manager to correct these shifts.
attendance.empty_me_text: Your clock-ins and clock-outs will appear here.
attendance.empty_team_text: Nobody clocked in for the selected period.
attendance.no_record_sub: Active staff with no clock-in on this day. This is not an absence report — DocBook does not keep staff shift plans.
attendance.correct_help: Leave clock-out empty if the person is still at the clinic. A clock-out earlier than the clock-in counts as the next day.
attendance.reason_ph: e.g. Forgot to clock out; left at 17:00
attendance.delete_confirm: Delete this attendance record of {name}? This cannot be undone.
attendance.setup_lead: A tablet or screen at reception shows a QR code. Staff scan it with their phone camera and tap Clock in or Clock out.
attendance.how_1: Open the attendance screen on a tablet at reception, signed in with an account that manages attendance.
attendance.how_2: The QR code changes every 10 seconds, so a photo of it stops working quickly. Several people can scan the same code at once.
attendance.how_3: Staff scan the code with their phone camera. If they are not signed in they sign in first, then scan again.
attendance.how_4: One tap records Clock in or Clock out with the server time, the phone's network address and browser.
attendance.screen_link_help: Open this address on the reception tablet. It needs an account with the attendance screen permission.
attendance.kiosk_security: Keep the tablet locked to this screen: whoever uses it is signed in with that account.
attendance.qr_only: Clock in/out only by scanning the QR code
attendance.qr_only_help: When on, the Clock in / Clock out button on each person's own page is hidden and staff must scan the code at the attendance screen.
attendance.scan_to_clock: Scan to clock in or out
attendance.scan_sub: Open your phone camera and point it at the code.
attendance.confirm_out: You are clocked in since {time}. Tap to record that you are leaving.
attendance.scan_again: Scan the code on the attendance screen again.
attendance.app_url_title: The site address (APP_URL) is not set
attendance.app_url_text: It is now “{current}”. Links in e-mails, invitations and password resets are built from it, so they point to the wrong address. (The attendance QR code already uses the address the site was opened on.) Set APP_URL = {suggested} in the server environment and restart the app.
attendance.reach_lan_help: This screen is open as “localhost”, which phones cannot reach, so the QR uses this computer’s network address instead. Staff phones must be on the same Wi-Fi as this computer:
attendance.reach_local: Phones cannot open this QR: the site is running as “localhost” and no network address was found. Open DocBook with its real address (or set APP_URL) and make sure staff phones can reach it.

errors_attendance.QR_INVALID: This QR code is not valid. Scan the code on the attendance screen.
errors_attendance.QR_EXPIRED: This code has changed. Scan the code currently on the attendance screen.
errors_attendance.ATTENDANCE_QR_ONLY: Your clinic records attendance by scanning the QR code on the attendance screen.
errors_attendance.ATTENDANCE_NOT_MEMBER: Your account is not an active staff member of this clinic.
errors_attendance.ATTENDANCE_OTHER_CLINIC: This code belongs to a clinic your account does not work at.
